messages.text: I am currently based in Bangalore, India.
Can we arrange a booking outside Bangalore?
Outstation requests can be discussed in advance, but travel and availability are not guaranteed.
What if I ask something a little adult?
You can ask respectfully. The assistant may discuss mature topics, but any claim about me must come from approved information.
Please use the official WhatsApp or Telegram contact options on the website rather than asking Rose to reveal private contact information.
